equations.EP_generation1: multinomial logistic regression, 7 outcomes (TD/opp-TD/FG/opp-FG/safety/opp-safety/no-score), features: down, distance, yardline, time, etc. — superseded by nflfastR XGBoost v3 (the 7-class matrix we already extracted)
equations.WP_generation1: GAM (mgcv) with EP as input + binomial smoother — the pre-XGBoost WP
equations.nflWAR: multilevel models isolating skill-player contributions; resampling-based uncertainty — the PLAYER-EQUATION layer we have not built
equations.key: the paper is the canonical citation for EP/WP; the CODE with actual feature lists is nflfastR v3 (already landed)
